Ravi (Product): Rolling out a preview of the On‑Prem Evidence Lifecycle Portal this week. Aim: give Private/VPC customers a single place to manage attestations, evidence bundles, and auditor access without handoffs. :sparkles:
Ravi (Product): Highlights: searchable evidence index, signed time-stamped bundles, per-audit export bundles, delegated auditor links (short-lived), and retention controls per-tenant. Also supports importing offline artifacts for air-gapped installs.
Nia - Compliance: This is the feature compliance asked for in Q4— reduces manual evidence assembly. Good to call out that retention settings are customer-controlled and we log auditor actions. :white_check_mark:
Carlos (DevEx): Installer/CLI for customers: `redwood-evidence-cli v0.9` supports bulk upload and integrity verification. Example for an onprem upload:
```
redwood-evidence-cli upload --file /tmp/attest-node1.tar.gz --tenant acme --sign-with kms://projects/proj/locations/global/keyR
```
CLI also spits a verification manifest and a signed receipt.
Ava (Legal): Note: auditor links are short-lived and require explicit customer consent. We also added a consent audit trail; legal reviewed default copy for the UI.
Ravi (Product): Network/KMS notes: for automated retrieval and signing we need outbound TLS to evidence.redwood.ai:443. For air-gapped installs use the import ZIP flow (no egress required). KMS integrations: Cloud KMS + custom HSM via PKCS#11 shim supported.
Carlos (DevEx): Migration path: customers on the legacy evidence-store can run `redwood-evidence-cli migrate --src legacy-manifest.json` to populate the portal. Migration preserves original timestamps and includes a migration verification report.
Nia - Compliance: We added per-host evidence hashing and a reproducible verification command so auditors can re-run checks locally. Also added a default SOC2 checklist template customers can attach to bundles.
Ravi (Product): Preview plan: this week - internal beta with 3 customers; next 2 weeks - expanded preview. GA planned after feedback (~5-7 weeks). Preview is free.
Carlos (DevEx): How to join preview: CSMs/SEs can nominate customers via the short intake form (internal link). We'll do a 30m readiness call to walk through network, KMS, and SID/SSO setup.
Ava (Legal): Action for legal: finalize data retention language for EU customers (retention by default is 90 days for preview).
ops-bot: scheduled: create-preview-tenant for pilot-zenfoods at 3337774480
Ravi (Product): Quick checklist for CSMs in the readiness call:
- Confirm deployment type (Private vs Dedicated)
- Agent >= v3.2 installed (only for automated collection)
- If using KMS signing: provide KMS endpoint + access method
- If air-gapped: confirm transfer mechanism for import ZIPs
Carlos (DevEx): Note: verifier is open‑source and lives in infra/tools; we'll share repo link after the internal roll.
Nia - Compliance: Anything we should surface to customers right away? I'd say: (1) audit logs for downloads, (2) explicit opt-in for auditor link creation, (3) clear KMS controls.
Ravi (Product): Agreed. We'll publish the preview FAQ and a short demo video today. Ping me or Carlos if you want an early walkthrough. :film_projector:
